company_info.company_description: "With a legacy of more than 15 years in energy, construction and telecommunication industry, our experts have spearheaded installation of commercial, residential, off-grid solar power systems, battery storage systems and solar farms across Australia.Our goal is to eliminate energy poverty in Australia by delivering quality solar solutions and ensure everyone has access to electricity at affordable prices while providing remarkable customer service."

reviews.review_description: It took a bit longer than we expected. However, everything is good in the end. Good value for money. Good teamwork. Highly recommended.

The installation team were professional, punctual and polite. The team of three took a full day to install a full roof of solar panels with a battery system. The Process was professional and straight forward. They connected me to the app and showed me how to use it, explained how the solar with gateway was configured and how the system works. The job site was left clean and the solar works as expected. Very pleased with the installation.

Thank you, Target Solar.We found Target Solar professional in every aspect.Very professional with constant communication from start to finish.On time when promised with calls or technicians arriving.Technicians clean work with caution to structure, roof tiles and answering questions along the way.Flexibility with time regards - Solar Panels and Battery.Special Call Out to Noor, who was the face and voice from start to finish, dealing with one person rather than several that can cause confusion… Thank you Noor and Target Solar …

We used Target Solar again after they installed our solar roof system in 2024. With the Federal and State grants we took advantage and installed a new battery system that coupled with the solar. I rang Target Solar (Sumit) and asked him based on the previous install what we could do. I stipulated that the battery system must be installed outdoors and match our current system. Sumit and his team did a fantastic job and the install happened very quickly. It was professional and we are very happy. I also installed a powerpal sensor on the smart meter, and you can see in real dollars what we were paying and what we are now.  It's now about $4.50 a day! The Battery App also allows you to see in real time the hope consumption.  We are very happy and highly recommend Target Solar .Alpha ESS Smile G3 B5 Battery Inverter and Alpha ESS 20.2 KWh Battery Storage
I got a quote from Target solar and once I accpeted, got the appointment for the installation straight away. The installer was very good. Did the job well. Happy that the batteries are now connected.

Quoting process was good.Price was not the cheapest but cheapest is not always the best overall option.The guys have better more competent technicians.They were not forceful or pushy in quoting either.

We recently had solar panels installed at our home by Target Solar, and the entire experience was fantastic. Noor was excellent throughout the project—he answered all my questions promptly and addressed any concerns with great care. Nicky was incredibly helpful in coordinating the installation schedule, ensuring everything went smoothly. The installation crew also went above and beyond by inspecting our roof tiles and replacing any weak or damaged ones (which I had on hand) before starting the installation. Such a reliable company to work with.

I recently had My Tesla Charger installed by Target Solar, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. The entire process—from consultation to installation—was smooth and hassle-free. The team that came out was incredibly friendly, respectful, and professional.They took the time to explain everything clearly and calmly, answering all my questions with patience and a positive attitude. It really made a difference having installers who not only knew what they were doing but also made me feel confident and comfortable with the whole setup.I highly recommend Target Solar to anyone considering going solar. Great service, great team, and a job well done!

Extremely happy with both the sales and installation teams for my recent 6.6kW solar install. Noor from Sales provided heaps of support throughout the quotation phase, giving me different options and competitive pricing. The installation team were friendly and very efficient, installing the whole system in half a day with great attention to detail and no compromise to workmanship. I'd highly recommend them to everyone. Thanks Noor, Andy and team :)

Quoting process was hard due to lack of English speaking employees. Installers left with out explaining much at all and were also poor in English. No one showed me anything. Price was good but everything else was poor. Not a happy experience.

After extensive research I had a 8kW solar collection system installed by Target Solar. The system consisted of 19 Trina panels and a Goodwe inverter. I am more than satisfied with the performance of the system and with the service and support from Target Solar. The staff at Target Solar answered all my pre-purchase questions and went to great lengths to assure me that the system was not over specified and would meet my needs. The installation went smoothly and  professionally, as did the commissioning of the system and after sales support. The financial  return, after 12 months was better than expected. I have no hesitation in recommending Target Solar.

Target Solar company installed the 22 solar panels and Fronius inverter in April 2019 at my newly built home in Truganina and like many others, I have also given 5 star google rating way back in 2019.After 5.5+ years in January 2025  where the warranty period is finished, I noticed that one of the line (MPPT2) was not generating power output at all and contacted Target Solar to have this issue fixed. I had to pay a whopping $550 to have a just $10 MC4 part replaced.First VisitJust one installer visited my home and did some checks on Fronius inverter for less than 5 mins and confirmed Inverter is working fine and then climbed the roof to isolate the problem for another 5-10 mins but couldn’t find the problem. So he spent in total around 15 mins and then left stating he has to come back with another installer to lift the panels and check if there is any broken connection.Second VisitTwo installers came and lifted around 5-6 panels and found out MC4 part has melted due to heat and replaced the broken part and solar panels are working fine now. They were at my place for around 35-40 minutes in the second visit.I got 2 invoices to pay.Invoice-1 of $220 for first visit where nothing was fixed.Invoice-2 of $330 to replace the MC4 connector which costs around $10 only.I have used the words “Looting Money” because1) Target solar will always send only one installer in first visit and sends two installer from second visit. They still charge for both the visits irrespective of whether they fix the issue or not. Target solar should realise that issue will be on the roof and lifting of solar panels will be required.2) Target solar use very low quality product, otherwise the MC4 part should not have melted in just 5.5 years.3) The Target solar head office in Truganina, Victoria is just 3 KM away from my home so they should not site the reason of too much travel time and their installer are always travelling around in the Melbourne west area.4) The sales representative lied to me in email stating all panels were lifted. Looks like they are unware that my lay over has MPPT1 with 11 panels and MPPT2 with 11 Panels. Even if they had to lift, the maximum panels would be 11. I have video recording from my security camera.5) Pay $550 to have a $10 MC4 part replaced.

I recently had solar installed in my house from Target Solar. The Representative Sumit was knowledgeable, Friendly and went above and beyond to ensure I was satisfied with my purchase. They responded promptly to my emails and Text messages. More importantly Very reasonable price.Highly recommend Target Solar.

Sales and quote is very competitive in the market. Good to deal with. Installation is nicely done neat and tidy, they rocked up on time.Customer service nice and swift communication.Will definitely recommend Target Solar

I am writing to express my sincere appreciation for the outstanding service provided by Target Solar during the recent installation of my solar energy system. From the initial consultation to the final activation, your professionalism, attention to detail, and commitment to excellence were truly commendable.Your team demonstrated exceptional expertise by carefully following up at every stage of the installation process. I was particularly impressed with the way you proactively addressed any challenges that arose, ensuring a seamless and efficient installation. Your willingness to go the extra mile to resolve issues promptly and effectively speaks volumes about your dedication to customer satisfaction.Beyond the technical aspect, the professionalism and courtesy of your staff made the entire experience smooth and stress-free. Their clear communication, punctuality, and thorough explanations reassured me that I had chosen the right company for this important investment.I am delighted with the final outcome and grateful for the effort your team put into making this project a success. Please extend my thanks to everyone involved. I will certainly recommend Target Solar to anyone considering solar energy solutions.Thank you once again for your excellent service. I look forward to enjoying the benefits of my solar system for many years to come.

Accurate and fast transaction for quotation and installation. I am happy with the flexibility and knowledge of solar products provided. Thorough explanation of the system and the availability for future expansion. Installed 2nd week of Dec 2024, and I am able to monitor the system everywhere.
Was all good, just waiting on final invoice and to be hooked up to the grid,
Sales was great, few errs in communication with admin and locale of the switch box but overall install went swimmingly

From quotation to installation Target Solar were great to deal with, very neat , efficient, helpful all throughout and a fair price. Looking forward to seeing how everything performs in the future, would certainly recommend Target Solar.
Sumit the sales reps was easy to deal with no harassing sale. Communication was from the start to the end. The installers came punctual and was also easy to deal with. Would Definantly recommend.

TARGET SOLAR is quite different from other solar energy provider we’ve dealt with. I have met Parvez Valani who did an excellent honest to goodness quotation and representation of their company. His knowledge of solar power system is exceptionally good. He recommends the best requirement of the household whether with or without the battery/ies. He provided continuous support and assurance of professional installation backed by his team. I can only described them as with magnificent workmanship and fast installation without sacrificing fine details. Planning and  directions from an efficient leading hand who is strong and punctual as well as his assistants were just as consistent. After the installation, the lead man explained how the inverter works and to track its performance from the SEMS PORTAL.Target Solar’s Parvez Valani provided us all these and were supported by people from the office and men on site as I have described above. Too good to be true, but that was what we have witnessed. We’re now enjoying a Solar Powered energy system every one wants to target. TARGET SOLAR, no one else fits if you want to have peace of mind and comfort at home.

So here we are. Nov 2024. Power prices in WA are getting higher and our energy use is far too high a cost under the cost living problems we all have.  The government is not looking after its people well.  Power subsidies’ do not reduce energy costs!We had 2 options of a 6.6KW or 10 KW systems and I asked for quotes from a number or private businesses before approaching Solar Quotes.  Solar Quotes arranged 4 suppliers and after careful review settled on Target Solar. Sumit and Nicky from Target Solar were very professional, and we allowed ourselves plenty of time to schedule the works.  The trades persons installing the 10KW system were on time, polite and professional from start to finish. We have the APP to see how we are producing and seem to be producing more that we consume but as summer approaches this will equal out I expect.  The whole process from beginning to end has been very good.The installation information in the quote was very clear, what type of inverter, type of solar panels etc.Customer Service has been good with the ability to ask questions and get immediate answers.Looking forward to not paying high power bills anymore!Overall I would certainly recommend Target Solar for the cost, price and quality of the installation and product.Bill and Michelle
Salesman (Meet) spoke well and took time to explain all aspects. After-sales team took care of hiccups. Inspite of plan changes, experience was good overall.

The team moved fast and were responsive to any queries. The price was most competitive out of the other quotes.Unfortunately with the installation, we noticed a severely rusted screw used to fasten the inverter to the garage wall. I brought this up with Target Solar the day after installation and they liased with the installation contractor to come out and replace it - which was greatly appreciated. However it doesn't inspire the most confidence in wondering what screws/hardware was used to secure the solar panels on the roof where it's harder for a customer to inspect.

I had an outstanding experience with Target Solar from start to finish! They were incredibly responsive, providing quotes quickly and efficiently, and their team was a pleasure to work with throughout the entire process. From the initial consultation to installation, their professionalism and knowledge stood out.Andrew was friendly and helpful. PK and his team were punctual, organized, and made sure everything was cleaned up after installation. They also took the time to answer all my questions and explained the process in detail, ensuring a stress-free experience.The installation was quick, and the system has been running smoothly since. I’m already seeing significant savings on my energy bills and feel great about using renewable energy.I highly recommend Target Solar to anyone considering solar energy. Their excellent service, attention to detail, and commitment to customer satisfaction truly made this an enjoyable and seamless experience. I would definitely use them again!Thank you, Target Solar, for making the switch to solar so easy!

I was worried, bordering on being concerned, dealing with Sales people interstate. The process worked but all along I was troubled as to whether their knowledge of the conditions & geography of Adelaide was adequate. They assured me that they had a presences in Adelaide but my check of the address in their website did not seem to check out. A number of phone calls did take place and eventually I accepted their quote.The installer (Mark Green) soon set aside my lingering doubts - not by way of words but by total application to task & a debrief & handover that left me much more informed than I could believe.
Target Solar were very responsive for supplying quotes and organising installation. Installation was also quick, and system is running well.

Target Solar were excellent to deal with. Right from quotation stage to the installation stage. Sumit was able provide me with a great price and Adam was very friendly to deal with. I would definitely use them again!
Target Solar were quick to respond with a quote with options, to fine-tune the quote following my questions, and to install the system. Very responsive and professional.

I recently had my solar panels installed by Target Solar, and I couldn't be happier with the experience!From the initial consultation to the final installation, Chirag and  team was professional, knowledgeable, and friendly. They took the time to answer all my questions and provided a clear explanation of the installation process and expected savings on my energy bills.Chirag's team were punctual, efficient, and respectful of my property. They completed the installation in a timely manner and ensured everything was cleaned up before leaving.Since the installation, my energy bills have significantly decreased, and I love knowing that I'm using renewable energy. I highly recommend Target Solar for anyone considering solar energy. They truly made the process easy and stress-free!Thank you, Target Solar, for a fantastic experience!

?????I had an excellent experience with Target Solar. Their team was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly efficient. The installation process was smooth, and they kept me informed every step of the way. I’m thrilled with the results and already noticing the benefits. Highly recommend Target Solar to anyone considering solar energy!
Super quick, great support and amazing workmanship.  Understand the need of client

It was a long process due to the complexity of the job. However, the team at Target Solar resolved all issues and installed the system. Communicated almost weekly with myself regarding any issue or system upgrade that needed to be required. Special thanks to Sumit and Damien for your patience and efforts regarding my installation.

- The sales process was good and informative. Good to have had the face to face- The installation- Punctual, extremely polite and very tidy. A rarity- exceptional tradies- The after install was smooth. Target took care of everythingNot apperaing under 'optionals'. The Inverter is Sungrow and the Panels are Tiger Neo N-type 54HL4R-(V)

Target Solar provided me with a great setup at an affordable price. I pursued them through a platform (bid my solar) where I was trusted that this company had been around for a while and were on the ball with everything. The installers did a great job with no corners cut and took their time to ensure everything not just worked but looked micky mouse. Would recommend to any of my family or friends.
It’s been great experience having service from Target solar. Great support staff. Very professional staff. Very punctual staff members. Highly recommended company.

I want to express my gratitude to (target solar) for outstanding service they provided, especially Noor is highly skilled and product knowledge, his professionalism and detail were commendable. Made my decision hassle-free over choosing the right product. He is very understanding, helpful and gave excellent customer service. I highly recommend their service to anyone in need of reliable, fantastic service and trustworthy.

Great customer service - it all started a year ago when Sarav took the initiative to visit our residence and spend time with us explaining various optionsIt took us a year to decide as we had to chop off a few trees, when we restarted the conversation Parvez visited is to seal the dealThey are not the cheapest nor are the most expensive however they provide the confidence & service to make it worthwhile engaing themWe reviewed multiple options, they did not push any but with our location the choice was obviousThanks Tsrget SolarRegardsDipen

Quoting process was easy with Patrick, he listened to our needs and budget.  They were the best of 4 quotes received and I undertook a full procurement elevation of each supplier quote!A week later the installation team arrived at the time stated and the job was complete by 2pm.  They were tidy & polite.in addition to installation, they took away our old 1.5kms system.

The whole process was made quite simple. I felt that I was getting good advice and a competitive price for my install. The system was installed quickly and up and running as promised with no issues at all.

Target Solar responded promptly to all communication.Installation occurred on the scheduled date and went smoothly.  I had an issue with the wireless communications. It turned out to be a failed comms module which was replaced under warranty at no expense.

The whole process from beginning to end has been very good. The installation information in the quote was very clear, what type of inverter, type of solar panels etc.The installation was very quick after accfeptance of the quoted price. The installers arrived on time as detailed and did a very good job of the whole removal of the old system and install of the new system.Customer Service has been good whith the ability to ask questions and get immediate answers.Overall I would certainly recomend Target Solar for the cost, price and quality of the installation and product.

Sales and quoting process was excellent.Patrick was very helpful and knowledgeable.Install was very quick and efficient,great products and value for money.Andy was very helpful and PK and his crew were a great pleasure to deal with during installation.
The sales , installation and follow up process was excellent! The whole team needs to be thanked, they also assisted in fixing an issue due to a power outage

I went to Target Solar by word of mouth. I got in touch with Noor. He was extremely honest, helpful and friendly . There was no pushy attitude. I got lots of support pre and post installation. Things were done in no time. There were no hidden costs. Highly recommend them.

I did my research before and some of the negative review for TargetSolar was based on them not having their own installation team in NSW and probably due to bad contractor there are some bad jobs reported in rural NSW. My experience is this doesn't apply for Sydney metro region. Yes they did use contracted installer, but the service quality was very good, have no complain.Value: I obtained about six quotes from various suppliers and TargetSolar was the best by a very far margin.Design phase: Noor and the team was quite good adapting to my requests. I asked for tilted installation and specific brand of panel, as well as going through details of shading profile/inverter location. They are very knowledgable and accommodated all my needs.Installation quality: had no issue, the installation team was professional, good quality installation and site fully cleaned up at the end of day.Post installation service: extremely efficient and streamlined. They helped me sorting our the last bit (connecting with my electricity provider). I barely have to do anything.5/5 service, will recommend to everyone.

Great experience with Target solar from start to finish. Chirag was knowledgeable and helpful in designing the system with my preferences in mind while offering a very competitive price. Nicky was proactive with organizing the logistics and always prompt replying to any emails. I would recommend Target Solar.
Excellent customer service throughout the quoting and installation process.  Quick turnaround and very smooth installation on the day.  Highly recommend.

-Sales and quoting process was great,The Salesperson was really helpful (Mr. P) He is proactive given that I am particular with what I want.-Installation team was good, I like how they organize the pipes on the inverter, on the other hand, installer are not that punctual and the installation + configuration of the inverter took 4 working days all together. Anyway the installer are great, it's just a combination of little things that makes the installation time longer.Customer service is great as well (Ms. N) she is just ready to assist me during and after installation.

Noor, Nicky and the team at Target solar were friendly, efficient and respectful. Noor is the salesperson and ensured I got the best price, all my many questions answered and a lot of follow up even after install. The installation was quick and the installers were very polite, and thorough. They know their job and a good at what they do. They explained and installed the app. GoodWe support also helpful.

Thank you Target Solar. Selected from a number of installers, some others also recommended by Solar Quotes. Their price range options were very competitive. They were very efficient in providing options for my installation, maintaing good communication over the process and the final work undertaken by an efficient and competant team.I recommend this company to others wishing to carry out an installation.
Nicky helped sort out all the steps as well as assisting with the governmental hoops to jump through.Install was a smooth process and no broken tiles even.

The quote was more than $2000 cheaper than the original quote from another supplier, but with more kilowatt potential. The panels (Jinko) were one of the highest rated on your website, Finn, and so was the inverter I think. There was a slight problem during installation inasmuch as telecom disc on our roof was casting a shadow on some of the panels but the installers found a work-around for that at minimal additional cost. One of the fuses on our powerbox was faulty but the installers went off and sourced a replacement despite it being a Sunday. Overall we are very satisfied with the quote, customer service and installation and would recommend TargetSolar. Of course the proof of the pudding is in the eating, and we havent received our first bill under solar, but we are confidently expecting something like a 70% saving. Will let you know if that is not the case!

Completed Installation in Western Melbourne region. The whole process was seamless from start to finish. Noor explained the ideal panel configuration and inverter requirement for the house. Did not upsell anything than what's required.Delivery was scheduled on Thursday to receive the panels. Installation was on the following Monday.The Installation team took 10 hours roughly for a colourbond roof. Had to modify the orientation of the PVC panels on the roof due to downpipe roof clashing. No additional cost was incurred apart from the inverter.Roughly took 3 weeks from quote to installation and the quote was requested on Christmas 2023.The only caveat is that when the email was sent out , I only noticed the installation date but didn't realize the delivery date was only mentioned on the second line item. If you can bullet point separately that would be ideal.Will definitely recommend for Western Melbourne
Great installer, only took 1 week from when we signed to having the panels installed on the roof, target has been very helpful and would recommend if you are thinking of installing solar.
Everything went well.  Great bunch of guys. Very friendly. Tidied up after themselves. Communication was great.Too soon to know if it will work to our expectations
Easy to deal with .. excellent installation and great after installation service as well .. couple of minor issues and were rectified quick smart .. highly recommended target solar

Quick turnaround from signing contract to install, all completed within a couple of weeks, Target solar team there throughout the whole process from install to grid connection, couldnt have done anymore to support me.Thankyou Target Solar

Quoting process was exceptionally good and everything from beginning to end was handled well. Installation was smooth and easy without any issues. Installers were tidy and didn’t leave any mess. Target solar salesman Meet was very professional and knowledgeable and very helpful answering questions.

The installation was complete and the whole process was smooth. I would like to extend and convey our sincere thanks to the installation team who performed an excellent job within the agreed time frame. They were extremely professional with no inconvenience caused to the household.

Target solar representative worked diligently in discussing the pro's and con's of the system capacity options and then changing my quotation to meet our personal needs.They organized and follow up on all required commissioning documentation including application paperwork for grid connection.House inspection and actual Installation was completed in a safe, timely manner and to Australian Standards, reflected by the State's inspectors onsite visit.

Sales quoting process was simple and not stressful at allInstallation was done extremely quickly. There was no mess and they arrived when expected. All the workers were very nice and friendly.All communication was helpful with all my questions answered promptly.Would highly recommend this company

Quoting process was straight forward, Target Solar calculated best fit system size based on roof space and direction. And existing power usage.The installation was quick, all done in one day. Was shown the system and was working from day one.They did all the organising for the meter replacement, we just had to make confirm with the retailer that was OK to do that day.

Pervaiz was quite professional. The quoting process was great however if the amount finalised including GST was made clearer it would have been excellent.The installation went very smooth. All the workers were quite professional and knew what they were doing. The wrorkers were professionals and they cleared everything before they left.The customer service was excellent and with all our queries we got a very prompt reply from the whole team. All our questions and concerns were dealt with clarity and professionalism.I would highly recommend Target solar to my friends and family.

We chose Target Solar  asked on reviews we had read. After getting three quotes, it was the customer service aspect of dealing with Target Solar- in particular their sales rep, Meet - he was so knowledgeable and went out of his way to ensure we were satisfied with our decision.Our installation process posed them some logistical issues and yet Meet made us feel comfortable as he resolved it all and engaged a very competent team of electricians to do our installation.Once started the actual installation ( and removal of our old system ) was seemless and happened cleanly and quickly with little disruption to us or our neighbors.Meet is an asset to their company.A & K
Installation was ok. Rescheduling from installer part and slow response from grid company, took a bit longer than expected to enjoy our solar system.

We had really good experience in installing the new Solar panel. Sales person was patient enough to respond to all our queries and gave us some good clarity on what Solar/inverter we required based on our daily usages.And they have have organized for the Grid connection once after the solar installation.

The quoting process was good and the installation went well . However i was told it would take only a day and it actually took 2 days but all went well in the end. The installers were polite but arrived quite late making the finish time when it was getting dark. They have helped in the grid connection after the install and in getting my app up and running.

- Sales and quote is easy.- Installation is a breeze, on-time and easy to deal with.- Post-installation customer service is excellent.  I had to deal with two separate issues re: inverter app and Princy G.  responded timely and look into the issue consistently until issue is resolved.

All good, apart from the faceless face of the company.  Everything is done via phone or email (overall service was good) with no human interaction with the company (in fact at first I feared they were a spoof and I had been scammed), but the response time and quality was always good.I think their overall customer service would be better if they had some human interaction with the customer (but I presume that adds to the price).Price wise both recommended installers were roughly the same, but they were both about $5,000 cheaper than a local installer I contacted and who came out to check the site and talk to me.I went with Target Solar due to their superior feedback ratings on google.The installers took their time but in the end did a good job (better slow and good than the other way around).

Target Solar were very responsive during the sales/quoting process. Following an initial call to better understand what I was looking for, they presented me with a few options and took the time to work with me to fine-tune and better understand the technical details on all options. In the end, after quite a bit of deliberation, the final system I went with was exactly as originally quoted which I think demonstrates that Target Solar took the time to consider my specific circumstances and quoted accordingly, rather than providing a template quote.From there things didn't move as quickly as I had hoped on account of some uncertainty around my existing meter installation, but once resolved the installation proceeded promptly. On installation day there was still some uncertainty around different aspects of the installation that I think could have been resolved prior with a site visit, but overall the installation process was relatively straight-forward.My system has been online for over a month now and has been operating without any issues. My follow up questions after installation have also been dealt with quickly. Overall I've been very happy with the whole process with Target Solar.
A very streamlined process. Installation was very coordinated end to end. Installation team was professional, punctual and fast. Great customer service.
Good installation process. I was well informed at each step, so it was hassle free.

We have had 2 separate solar panel installation projects completed by Target Solar and would highly recommend them. The work was completed as scheduled with a professional team. All round A1 experience.

Target Solar team went above and beyond our expectations with their professionalism. Their customer services team and the installers were highly professional. Any concerns we had about the solar system during pre and post-installation were swiftly resolved and they genuinely maintain customer satisfaction as their number one priority. The entire team that we dealt with were polite and professional. We highly recommend Target Solar for your solar installation project.

I chose target solar from at least 10 other companies because of their competitive quote for 13 KW system with Canadian solar panels and feronius inverter. Quote process was smooth and they booked us in with installer after taking deposit. Please note their installers are not employed but sub contracted. One installer came on booked day and refused to do installation as found out roof was very steep and 13 Kw will not fit. They said they can only do 9.9 KW. However we refused and contacted company again. They decided to send another installer for second opinion. This took several days for other installer to come and checked. They agreed to do 13 KW system but with added cost. So the situation is the quote has now increased from original one. We paid deposit on 14/03/2022 but there is still no system on our roof. The new date of installation is 10/05.

The overall process from quoting to installation was quite smooth. I would like to rate the service as per below,Communication : 5/5Installation : 5/5Cost : 4.5/5Information : 5/5Quality : 5/5Thanks for your support on bringing Solar system at my home with such a short notice.
Good communication all the way, from quote to fine tuning options and discussion about panel locations.

The team from Target Solar have been a pleasure to deal with. Noor helped design the system and the installers and support staff have been top notch. Woulkd definately go with them again in the future.

Target Solar gave us a competitive quote and understood our complex roof. The panels arrived on the morning of the installation and everything was hooked up and complete by the end of that day. I found them easy to work with and they've met my expectations.
The whole process was effortless and easy from great communication from beginning to end. Installation was a breeze and the installers were fantastic.Enjoying the benefits of Solar !!!

Sam from Target Solar offered a quick initial quote, but was happy to visit my home within days and discuss the details and finalise a new quote because I wanted to pay a little more for a higher end inverter.The installation was organised quickly after, and the installers were friendly and thorough, and even offered to remove an ancient broadband-internet-satellite dish that would very slightly shade the new panels.Target Solar also helped begin communications with my provider to organise my meter upgrade.I'm happy with my new solar system and will recommend both Target Solar and solarquotes to friends and family

Excellent service could not recommend them highly enough, Noor was my main contact through the whole process and the communication was excellent.The installation went smoothly with minimal fuss or mess left behind,their installers were professionally and polite and turned up at the time stated,would highly recommend.
All the Target team were good to deal with.  Sam patiently answered our questions and Princy has been really helpful.  The system is working well and we're glad we chose Target Solar.
Target solar guided me through the govt rebate process , designed the solar panel system with max capacity achieved and installed the system .Sales and customer service was great. Highly recommended

Target Solar are a very professional outfit. The sales rep Noor who I dealt with answered all my questions and he and his team were very helpful. Recommend Target Solar if you are interested in Solar for your home.
Target Solar representative Noor was very professional and helpful. I found the quote competitive
Everything went well as far as Target Solar was concerned.

As we were new to solar power it was important to have a company who answered emails and questions so we were able to make decisions.Installation is complete and working and we're enjoying making the best use of the sun.

After some back and forth initially regarding the amount of panels, all went very smooth. Installers were punctual and did a great job on the day. Post installation process is at stage still underway, but seems on track.

After trusting cheapest online offer for 6.6Kw system, I lost my 100$ deposit. so after that I was very cautious with my next pick for solar installer, but I have to say second time I have much more luck with installer. Noor on the phone was very helpful and trying to explain every question possible. installation process went very smoothly, done on the date agreed, and without any extra cost. Because of my first bad experience with solar installer we agreed to paid the whole amount at the completion of work, which I was grateful for that. Target solar organised grid connection at the end, system is only 2 months old, but so far no issue at all. overall very happy customer. Thanks Target Solar
